notes: Guides written for this entry in the recorded build session, in our own words; names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them. Where an official description does not pin a place or trigger down, the guide says so instead of inventing one.
list: Official PlayStation trophy list as published, via Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on all 55 names, descriptions and grades).

sources.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then strangers and side missions, then collectibles, then activities, and finish with the money and choice trophies in stage 5. Do the 7 missable trophies during the story, before their windows close, so no second playthrough is needed for the platinum.
steps: Follow the five roadmap stages in order, top to bottom.
Clear the 7 missable trophies while the story is still running.
Use the checklist here to track the last few stragglers.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the opening mission Gone Fishing and it pops at the mission-complete screen. It is the first mission of the game, so this is one of the earliest trophies you will earn. No special approach is needed — just play the mission through to its end.
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission in Chapter 1 and it pops when the chapter closes. Chapters are the game's big story blocks, so just keep playing the story missions in order. Nothing in Chapter 1 can be missed for this trophy — the chapter itself is the requirement.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 1's story missions.
The trophy pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission in Chapter 2 and it pops when the chapter closes. The name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Keep playing the story in order; chapter trophies cannot be missed.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 2's story missions.
The trophy pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission in Chapter 3 and it pops when the chapter closes. By this point the map is well opened up, so it is a good moment to start the side content that feeds the stage 2 and 3 trophies — but the chapter trophy itself only needs the story missions done.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 3's story missions.
The trophy pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission in Chapter 4 and it pops when the chapter closes. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so before pushing on, check the missable list — Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Capital Offense and Personal Best all need the story still running.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 4's story missions.
Before the finale, clear any open missable trophies.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and one of only two golds: finish the final mission and it pops at the credits. Because the finale closes the story, do every missable trophy and every story-adjacent activity before starting it — once the credits roll, partner windows and one-time set pieces are gone. After the finale, free roam stays open for collectibles, activities and cleanup.
steps: Clear the 7 missable trophies before the finale.
Play the final mission to the end.
The gold pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Breakfast Run. Named story missions like this one are single missions inside the chapters, so the trophy pops as soon as that mission is complete. Just play the story in order and it comes on its own.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story.
Complete the mission to the end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the heist mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are the big set pieces of the story — follow the planning beats the game gives you, then the heist itself, and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story.
Complete the heist mission to the end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies, it only asks that the mission itself be completed — no special conditions, no rating requirement. Play it through and the trophy pops.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story.
Complete the mission to the end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Headliners. The name is stylised exactly as PlayStation prints it. Play the mission through to its end and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
steps: Reach Headliners in the story.
Complete the mission to the end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission VCIA Takedown. VCIA is the game's Vice City airport, so expect an airport set piece. Complete the mission and the trophy pops — no extra condition beyond finishing it.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story.
Complete the mission to the end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. The name suggests a heavy combat operation — bring full armour and your best weapons, play it through, and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Complete the mission to the end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold: reach 100% completion on the in-game stats page. That means the story, all stranger strands, every collectible set, the activities and the counted challenges — effectively everything else in this guide except the platinum itself. Check the stats page often: it breaks completion down by category, so it tells you exactly which bucket is still short. It is a stage 5 trophy — chase it last, after the roadmap's other stages are done.
steps: Finish the story, strangers, collectibles and activities first.
Open the in-game stats page to see which category is short.
Clear the short categories until the counter reads 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, airtime, near-misses and the like all feed the same counter, which you can watch on the stats page. The grind is the point: fold stunt attempts into every drive instead of doing them in one block, and use fast bikes and open ramps for the big-air ones. Stunt jumps marked on the map are the reliable source; repeat the easy ones while travelling between other objectives.
steps: Attempt stunts on every drive — jumps and airtime count.
Use stunt jumps marked on the map for reliable completions.
Watch the counter on the stats page; it needs 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type in the game at least once — one race, one fishing trip, one arcade game, one shooting-range challenge, one hunt, and so on. You do not need to win or finish them all, just sample each type. The fastest way is to work down the activity list in this guide: each activity trophy you chase also ticks one type off here, so it usually pops naturally during stage 4.
steps: Open the activities list and note the types you have not tried.
Play one session of each untried type.
The trophy pops when the last type is sampled.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 of them, per the official list. Go weapon by weapon: learn each challenge's target pattern, then replay it until the gold threshold is met. Steady aim beats speed here; use cover where the challenge allows it, and replay the hardest challenges last once your aim is warm. The range tracks each challenge's best medal, so you can see which ones are still short.
steps: Open the Shooting Range and work through the challenges by weapon.
Replay each challenge until it shows a gold medal.
All 42 must be gold — check the range's medal list for stragglers.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every Top Fun location. Each location hosts its own race, so you need a win at each one, not several wins at one. Learn a location's course first with a slow practice run, then race it for real: cut corners where the gates allow and keep the drone low to hold speed. The map shows the Top Fun spots, so work through them one by one.
steps: Find each Top Fun location on the map.
Win one drone race at each location.
Re-race any location that still shows no win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the word different matters: twenty wins in the same event count as one. Mix race types (street, off-road, drone, boat) and locations, and take the easiest events first. Upgrading your vehicle for the race class you are weakest in pays off faster than grinding one hard event. The game tracks which events you have won, so you can see which twenty you have banked.
steps: Race across types and locations, not one event repeatedly.
Win the easiest events first to bank wins fast.
Twenty distinct event wins pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head fishing contest, not free fishing. Use the best rod, line and bait you can buy before the challenge, and watch the tension meter: reel in when the fish runs toward you, ease off when it pulls hard, and never let the line snap. Cal is a named rival, so the challenge appears where he does — take it when it is offered and retry it if the first attempt gets away.
steps: Buy the best rod, line and bait available first.
Take Cal's fishing challenge when it is offered.
Mind the tension meter — ease off on hard pulls, reel on slack.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game — play an arcade cabinet through to its ending. Pick the shortest cabinet you can find and learn its pattern; most arcade games in the series are short score chases, so a few focused attempts should finish one. Any cabinet counts, so choose the game you are best at rather than the flashiest one.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet and start a game.
Play it through to its ending.
Any completed arcade game pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand — play every mission Andy gives you, down to his final one. Stranger and contact strands work the same way: a character hands you missions one at a time, and the trophy pops when their last mission is complete. Find Andy's marker on the map and keep returning to it until his strand ends.
steps: Find Andy's marker and start his strand.
Complete each of Andy's missions in turn.
The trophy pops when his final mission ends.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand — play every mission Kenton gives you, down to his final one. The name hints at boats, so expect water work in his strand. Keep returning to Kenton's marker until his missions run out; the trophy pops when the final one is complete.
steps: Find Kenton's marker and start his strand.
Complete each of Kenton's missions in turn.
The trophy pops when his final mission ends.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand — play every mission Billy gives you, down to his final one. The name points at solo riding, so expect bike work in his strand. Keep returning to Billy's marker until his missions run out; the trophy pops when the final one is complete.
steps: Find Billy's marker and start his strand.
Complete each of Billy's missions in turn.
The trophy pops when his final mission ends.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger markers appear on the map as you explore; each one is a small chain of missions for one odd character. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have their own strand trophy, and those five count toward these eight — so finish those five first, then find three more strangers. Explore every region, because stranger markers only show up once you have been near them.
steps: Finish the strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
Explore each region to reveal more stranger markers.
Complete three more full strands to reach 8.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand — play every mission Randy gives you, down to his final one. The name points at moving goods, so expect supply runs in his strand. Keep returning to Randy's marker until his missions run out; the trophy pops when the final one is complete.
steps: Find Randy's marker and start his strand.
Complete each of Randy's missions in turn.
The trophy pops when his final mission ends.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand — play every mission Tyrone gives you, down to his final one. Keep returning to Tyrone's marker until his missions run out; the trophy pops when the final one is complete. His strand counts toward the 8 needed for Strangers & Freaks, so it is worth finishing early in stage 2.
steps: Find Tyrone's marker and start his strand.
Complete each of Tyrone's missions in turn.
The trophy pops when his final mission ends.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. The spots are scenic viewpoints — cliffs, beaches, hilltops — and meditating at one marks it done. Work region by region so none is skipped: once a spot is found, sit and meditate before moving on. The map does not list every spot up front, so explore the edges of each region and look for viewpoint markers.
steps: Explore each region looking for meditation viewpoints.
Meditate at every spot you find before moving on.
Work region by region until no spot is left.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a named, one-of-a-kind animal he asks you to track down. Bret's strand gives the target: follow his clues to the animal's territory, approach downwind so it does not spook, and take a clean shot with a rifle. Unique animals do not respawn the same way, so take the shot carefully rather than rushing in. The trophy pops when Bret's hunt is turned in.
steps: Start Bret's strand and take the hunt he offers.
Follow the clues to the unique animal's territory.
Approach downwind, take a clean rifle shot, turn it in.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden pickups scattered across Leonida — in shops, on rooftops, in out-of-the-way corners — and each set needs every card in it. Pick one set and hunt its cards to completion before starting another, so your progress stays organised. Cards you have found show in the collection screen, which tells you which sets are close to done.
steps: Check the collection screen to see which sets are closest.
Hunt one set's cards to completion before starting the next.
Three completed sets pops the trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — use the in-game WAiNK photo feature at 100 distinct spots. Landmarks, viewpoints, murals and odd corners all count as locations, so photograph as you travel rather than making a separate trip for each one. The counter tracks distinct locations, so repeating the same spot does not help. Fold it into the stage 3 exploration: every new place you visit is a WAiNK opportunity.
steps: Use WAiNK at every new landmark or viewpoint you reach.
Fold it into exploration — 100 distinct spots are needed.
The counter only counts a location once, so keep moving.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges span everything — driving, shooting, flying, exploration — and they stack up naturally as you play the other stages, so check the list first before grinding. Pick off the easy ones early (short races, simple stunts, first-time activities), then work the longer ones in stage 4. The challenge menu shows your count, so you always know how many are left.
steps: Open the challenge list and note the easiest uncompleted ones.
Clear easy challenges first while doing other stages.
Fifty completed challenges pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.window: During the story, while your partner is with you. Closes when the story ends — do it before the final mission.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do it during the story while your partner is available: build a 4-star wanted level together, then lose it and escape. Rob a store or fight the police until the fourth star appears, then break line of sight, get out of the search cones, and stay hidden until the level clears. The trophy pops when the heat is gone and you are both free. Do not leave this for after the finale — partner free-roam is not guaranteed once the story ends.
steps: While partnered in the story, build a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and leave the search cones.
Stay hidden until the wanted level clears completely.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.window: During the story, while your partner is with you. Same partner window as Hot Together — closes when the story ends.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — same partner window as Hot Together: rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. The wanted level must stay alive across all three robberies, so drive between shops fast and do not let the heat clear between them. Plan a route of three close shops first, hit them in quick succession, and do not get busted. Pair it with Hot Together in one session: rob the shops, then lose the 4 stars you built up.
steps: Plan a route of three shops close together.
Rob them one after another with your partner, fast.
Keep the wanted level alive across all three — do not let it clear.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or enter 100 distinct vehicle models. Every new model you sit in counts, so hop into anything unfamiliar as you explore: parked cars, boats, bikes, trucks, aircraft. The collection screen shows which models you have found, so you can see which classes are thin. City traffic covers the common models; the rare ones hide in specific spots, so check the vehicle list when you are close to 100.
steps: Drive or enter every unfamiliar vehicle you see.
Cover all classes — cars, bikes, boats, trucks, aircraft.
Check the vehicle list for the rare models when near 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a crowd — a gang shootout or a police response — and trigger Combat Focus only when five or more enemies are in view and grouped. Use an automatic weapon and sweep across them; the slow-down window is short, so do not waste it on one target. If the group scatters, back out and try the next crowd instead of chasing stragglers.
steps: Find a fight with five or more enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus with them all in view.
Sweep with an automatic weapon — all five must fall in one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City airport. Our read, from the official description alone: get onto the airfield and leave in an aircraft without a scheduled flight — take a plane from the runway and get airborne. Expect airport security to respond, so go in with a fast vehicle, reach a plane quickly, and take off before the response closes in. No community guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet, so treat the runway departure as the attempt.
steps: Reach VCIA, the Vice City airport, with a fast vehicle.
Get to a plane on the airfield and take off from the runway.
An unscheduled departure — leaving without a ticket — is the trigger.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank — the description's joke is the clue: it is hot in a Rhino because the whole map wants you dead once you are driving one. Steal a Rhino from a military base or a convoy, then survive the response it draws. The trophy is about the tank, not a kill count, so focus on getting in and staying alive rather than fighting everything at once.
steps: Find a Rhino tank — military base or convoy.
Steal it and drive it out.
Survive the response it draws.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — no alarm, no witness, no wanted level. Go at night, move quietly, take out the cameras or avoid their cones, and get in and out before anyone raises the alarm. If a clerk or guard spots you, the attempt is blown: leave, lose any heat, and try again. A suppressed weapon and patience beat speed here.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and scout its cameras and staff.
Go at night, move quietly, avoid every camera cone.
Rob it and leave without any alarm or witness.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault is a planned job: crack the vault, grab the take, then lose the wanted level before the next attempt. Plan the escape before the entry — a fast car parked close by, and a route out of the search area. Five vaults, five clean escapes; a busted attempt does not count, so only clean getaways move the counter.
steps: Plan each vault job with an escape car parked close by.
Crack the vault and take the money.
Escape and lose the wanted level — five clean vaults in all.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes through the city — follow one until it stops at a quiet stretch, then hit it: block it, crack the rear doors, take the cash, and get clear before the police close in. The escape is the hard part, so have a fast car ready and a route away from the main roads. One clean truck robbery pops the trophy.
steps: Follow an armored truck to a quiet stretch of its route.
Block it, crack the rear doors, take the cash.
Escape and lose the wanted level.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit every named area of the state. The map fills in as you travel, so the trophy is really a travel checklist: drive, fly and sail into every region until no part of the map is left blank. Work outward from Vice City into the countryside and the Keys, and check the map for grey patches you have not crossed. It pairs naturally with the other stage 3 collectibles — explore while you hunt cards, meditation spots and WAiNK locations.
steps: Travel every region until the map has no blank patches.
Drive, fly and sail — some areas need a boat or a plane.
Check the map for grey areas and cross them.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — one hit per gang, across all of Leonida's gangs. Gangs run their own rackets (stash houses, drug labs, chop shops); find one operation per gang, rob it, and escape. The map and street intel point at gang territory, so work gang by gang and tick them off as you go. The trophy pops when every gang has been hit once.
steps: Find each gang's territory and its illegal operation.
Rob one operation per gang.
Escape after each hit; the trophy pops when all gangs are done.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — go to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. It is a quiet moment trophy: sit at the bar, order the drink, and let the scene play. Ocean Beach is the Vice City beachfront strip, so head for the bars with an ocean view and order at the counter.
steps: Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail at the counter.
Stay for the view — the trophy pops as the drink is enjoyed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.window: Your first visit to a vehicle showroom in the story. One-time set piece — do it on that first visit, before the story moves on.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do it on your first showroom visit in the story: drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the front, in classic style. The description frames it as a one-time set piece, so hit the glass on that first visit rather than saving it for later. Pick a car already inside or drive one in, then floor it through the front window and keep going until you are clear of the building.
steps: On your first story visit to a vehicle showroom, be ready.
Get in a car and drive straight through the showroom glass.
Keep going out the front until you are clear.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — bowl a game there and see it through to the end. Head to the alley, start a game, and play every frame until the game is complete. The follow-through is the point: finishing the game matters more than the score, so stay until the last frame is bowled.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game and play every frame.
Finish the game to the end — the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.window: During the story, while partner activities are available. Play partner content as it comes — do not leave it until after the finale.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the description is deliberately vague: a partnership moment with mass appeal. Our read, from the description alone: a shared highlight with your partner, a partner activity done well. Treat it as a story-adjacent beat: play the partner activities as they come during the story, and do them well rather than rushing past. No community guide has pinned down an exact trigger yet, so do not leave partner content until after the finale.
steps: Play partner activities as they appear during the story.
Do them properly — the trigger is a highlight moment.
Clear partner content before the final mission.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.window: The whole playthrough. A skipped choice cannot be remade, so choose every time the game offers one — it closes at the finale.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in spirit: the description points at choices, and a choice you skip cannot be remade. Our read, from the description alone: make choices whenever the game offers them — dialogue picks, approach picks, mission choices — across the whole playthrough. Always pick an option instead of skipping past it, and make the call yourself rather than letting a timer decide. The trophy should pop once enough choices have been made; treat it as a habit for the full game, not a single event.
steps: Choose an option every time the game offers one.
Never skip a dialogue or approach choice.
Keep choosing through the whole playthrough — it adds up.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.window: Any retryable mission or challenge — but it must be the immediate retry. If you play clean, do it deliberately early, before the finale.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — second time's the charm. Our read, from the description alone: fail a mission or challenge once, then clear it on the immediate retry. If you are playing clean, deliberately fail a short mission once and replay it right away; the trophy should pop on the successful retry. Do it early rather than late: the retry must follow the failure immediately, so a mission you already cleared clean cannot be used for it.
steps: Pick a short, easy mission or challenge.
Fail it once, on purpose if needed.
Clear it on the immediate retry — the trophy pops then.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.window: A one-time sighting somewhere in Leonida. When something strange happens, stay and watch it play out — walking away may lose it.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — witness something strange. Our read: a scripted oddball encounter somewhere in Leonida; the description gives no location and no community guide has pinned one down yet. Keep an eye on stranger markers and odd map locations as you explore, and when something strange happens, stay and watch it play out instead of walking away. Treat it as a one-time sighting: it may not repeat.
steps: Explore odd map locations and stranger markers.
When something strange happens, stay and watch it.
Do not walk away mid-event — it may be one-time only.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by — a drive-by attack with a melee weapon that knocks a group over like pins. Our read, from the description alone: drive slowly past a group of pedestrians with a melee weapon ready, swing as you pass, and bowl several over in one pass. Pick a crowded sidewalk, keep the speed low so the swing connects, and aim for a tight group. The bowling name is the joke: the group is the pins.
steps: Find a crowded sidewalk with a tight group of pedestrians.
Drive past slowly with a melee weapon ready.
Swing as you pass and bowl the group over in one drive-by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to a contact who cleans them, and the cleaned value counts toward the $250,000. It is a long grind, so launder after every big score instead of letting bills pile up — the contacts take a cut, so the total laundered is what counts, not the raw haul. Keep robbing and laundering in stage 5 until the counter hits $250,000.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts after each score.
Repeat until $250,000 has been laundered in total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative spending on weapons, clothes, vehicles, food and everything else. Normal play covers much of it: weapon upgrades, outfits, car mods and property purchases all count. If you are short near the end, spend on high-value items you actually want (a good car, weapon attachments) rather than throwing money away. The counter tracks total spending, so every purchase from the start of the game counts.
steps: Buy weapons, clothes, vehicles and mods as you play.
Check the spending counter when you are near the end.
Top up with high-value purchases you actually want.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties across Leonida. Garages are buyable properties that store your vehicles; each one has a price, so save up before hunting them down. The property menu lists the garages for sale — buy them one by one as money allows, starting with the cheapest. The trophy pops when the last garage is yours.
steps: Open the property menu to see the garages for sale.
Buy them one by one as money allows.
The trophy pops when every garage is purchased.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — open the app on your phone, pick a vehicle you own or have found, and register it. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you drive most, then fill the rest with cheap finds. The app tracks how many are registered, so you can see the count climb toward ten.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone.
Register a vehicle you own or have found.
Repeat until 10 vehicles are registered.
